# Azure Cost Analysis — Spend & Spike Detective

💳 Paid Azure subscription required — Curated by Skill Harbor — Microsoft's cost analysis skill: query historical Azure spend, break down costs by resource, investigate bill spikes and unexpected charges, and allocate AKS cluster and AI service costs — with dedicated workflows for cost queries, spike investigation, AKS cost analysis and AI spend analysis, strict about separating measured cost from inferred causes and labeling incomplete data. By @microsoft, listed here with credit to its creator. Honest caveats: analyzes actual billed spend only — explicitly NOT for forecasts, pricing estimates, rightsizing, commitments or budgets; you need Cost Management read access, and multi-currency results are reported separately.
